annotations.title: Hand a doctor over to HealthPass

description: Hand over a doctor you found so the traveller can request an appointment on HealthPass. This books nothing and sends nothing: it returns a link the traveller opens to sign in, check the doctor and send the request. Takes the doctor's details with their sources; it has no field for the traveller's name, diagnosis, condition or medication. HealthPass emails the practice only if the address appears on the practice's own website.
